name: Hospital Simulator 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Hospital Simulator is a hospital management game where you need to help your patients, hire some staff, and make sure everything goes well in your hospital! There are many things you can do in this game, such as diagnose the patients' sickness, send an ambulance, take the patients to the emergency room, do surgery on patients' eyes, look for foreign objects with X-rays, and more!
